bias.en: Bearish · rebound stalled under the 5-day average
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹受阻于 5 日均线下方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 2.2% on Oct 20 to $139.79, trading between $137.14 and $142.45; with 72 sessions of history there is no 100-day average yet. It is below its falling 5-day ($142.6), 10-day ($155.0) and 30-day ($176.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($169.35), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月20日下跌 2.2%，收于 $139.79，盘中区间 $137.14–142.45；上市仅 72 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$142.6）、10 日（$155.0）和 30 日均线（$176.4）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$169.35），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The Oct 19 rebound faded at the 5-day average, but the close held the $137.8 Oct 15 low. Resistance is $142.5 (5-day, day's high), then $148 (Oct 19 high) and $151.5 (Aug 24 low). Support is $137.1–137.8, then $136.2 (Oct 16 low) and $133.8 (Aug 7 low). A close above $142.6 would target $148; a close below $133.8 would open $124.8.
read.zh: 10月19日的反弹在 5 日均线处回落，但收盘守住 $137.8 的 10月15日低点。阻力为 $142.5（5 日均线、当日高点），其次 $148（10月19日高点）和 $151.5（8月24日低点）。支撑为 $137.1–137.8，其次 $136.2（10月16日低点）和 $133.8（8月7日低点）。若收盘站上 $142.6，下一目标看 $148；若收盘跌破 $133.8，下一目标看 $124.8。

bias.en: Bearish · lost the July low again
bias.zh: 偏空 · 再度跌破 7 月低点

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,223,000 in Seoul on Oct 20 after a low of ₩1,183,000. It is below its falling 5-day (₩1,251,400), 10-day (₩1,412,800) and 30-day (₩1,664,867) averages, the falling 100-day (₩1,896,320) and the rising 200-day (₩1,467,040). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 29 (₩1,498,122), and RSI is 25.
read.zh: SK 海力士 10月20日在首尔收于 ₩1,223,000，盘中低点 ₩1,183,000。股价位于下行的 5 日（₩1,251,400）、10 日（₩1,412,800）和 30 日均线（₩1,664,867）、下行的 100 日均线（₩1,896,320）及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,467,040）下方。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 9月29日起看空（₩1,498,122），RSI 为 25。

read.en: The close fell back under the ₩1,238,000–1,246,000 Oct 15 and Jul 29 lows, which now act as resistance, though the close held ₩1.2 million. Resistance is ₩1.25 million (those lows, 5-day average), then ₩1.33 million (Oct 15–16 highs) and ₩1.40 million (Oct 14 low, 10-day average). Support is ₩1,183,000–1,208,000 (Oct 19–20 lows), then ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close below ₩1,183,000 would open ₩1,060,000.
